title: Scam warning on a message
summary: An amber card on a received message that looks like a known scam pattern (falso parente, Pix code, boleto, fake bank alert and others). It says what to check, never that the message is a scam. A money request also pauses copy and pay for 5 seconds.

kind.description: The first kind in warningKindPriority (registries/scam-patterns.json) whose rule applies.

pauseSeconds.description: Seconds left on the money pause. Starts at 5 for the money kinds (pixCode, boleto, pixKey, deliveryFee), else 0.

victimSheetOpen.description: The I was scammed sheet is open.

check.effect: For each received text message (and each edit), runs the on-device scam check on the plain body and sets warning. Results are cached by event id and body.

url.description: A link in a message with a warning.

tapLink.effect: Money kinds: while pauseSeconds is above 0, the link does nothing and shows bipe_pause_countdown. Then, and for other kinds at once, the link opens.

copy.effect: Money kinds: copy of the Pix code, boleto line or Pix key follows the same pause.

scamVictim.effect: Opens a sheet with bipe_scam_victim_body (call the bank, ask for the MED return).

notes: The check runs on the device and never sends the message anywhere (security.md: on-device checks never phone home).

Rules: registries/scam-patterns.json, reference implementation tools/lib/registries.mjs, cases test-vectors/scam-detection.json and test-vectors/scam-warnings.json. Bipe logic: ScamDetector.matchIDs and ScamDetector.warningKind, ScamWarningKind (iOS); ScamDetector.matchIds and warningKind, ScamWarningKind (Android). Move them; do not write a new check.
Look (trust-ui.md): caution card, amber, outline icon, 1 pt border, above the message body, inside the bubble. Never red: red is only a hard name mismatch.

Money pause (parity money-pause, planned on both forks): 5 s from the first time the card is on screen (trust-ui.md Deliberate pause). After it the person decides; Bipe never blocks for good. With reduced motion the number changes with no animation. Pix request cards (phase 2) use the same pause.
No warning on the person's own messages. Messages from verified institutions follow the trust UI rules of phase 2.
Images that look like a receipt get bipe_warning_receipt_image; that check belongs to media (bipe-chat/bipe#561).
